issues.reason: Core patterns makes dual-emit mandatory for "a copular clause carrying a time modifier" (reified state AND the flat copular atom), and the Resultatives plural bullet fixes the plural form of that flat half as a per-member rule conclusion rather than a group atom, so the Keepers rule's conclusion must also carry `(Past (Member $x active))`.

Compound concepts says to decompose "once, to single-word lemmas, then stop" and that a noun modifier is "never exposed … leave those in the symbol", so mire_essence and salt_bloom — fragments of the minted compounds, never kinds the parse mints — license no genus atom of their own, unlike sky_cat which is itself minted as a kind at 38.

gaps_confirmed: stock expressed as time-to-exhaustion ("ten months of supply") — a measure phrase whose unit is time but whose dimension is stock has no licensed bearer; here the bearer is improvised onto the `hold` event

a verb+object gerundive compound used as a referring NP ("active station-tending") — the compound-action decomposition (genus on the verb + `Patient` on the compound symbol) is scoped to reified can/obligated/permitted terms and does not reach an ordinary referring NP

"returned to <activity>" — an abstract resumed activity as the object of "to"; the gap is real but narrower than filed, since the preposition-named oblique `(To <event> <object>)` is available — the residue is that `To` feeds the seeded `PurposeOf` bridge and would assert an aim the text does not state, leaving no collision-free head
"the late spring of Year 2" — no structured term exists for a season or a season sub-part, so it can only sit as a bare symbol beside `(Year 2)`
new_gaps: a day-ordinal within a year ("on day 720 of Year 2") — `(Day <n>)` is the day-of-month slot, so `(Day 720)` overloads it and cannot feed the seeded same-year-month day ordering; no term exists for a day-of-year count or a regnal-style year

a reported / estimated count ("the sky-cat census estimated fourteen sky-cats") — `estimate` takes an NP object, so nothing seals or hedges the count and `(GroupOf sk_group_1 sky_cat) (Cardinality sk_group_1 14)` lands as asserted fact; a licensed form would need to carry the count as the content of the estimate rather than as a standing group size
defect_summary: (1) The Keepers rule's conclusion must also carry the flat per-member half — (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_2) (And (Member (sk_active $x) active) (Experiencer (sk_active $x) $x) (Time (sk_active $x) (Day 720)) (Past (sk_active $x)) (Past (Member $x active)))) — so a flat "is this Keeper active?" binds. (2) The compliant form drops (Inheritance mire_essence essence) and (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) entirely, keeping only the first-level genus atoms (Inheritance mire_essence_reserve reserve) and (Inheritance salt_bloom_store store).
notes: The three "held N weeks of supply" clauses put the `Measure` on the hold event with scale `supply` — a dimension noun stated in the clause, so the scale itself is licensed even though the bearer is improvised; treating that as a gap rather than an issue is the right call. Stative-transitive `hold` / `estimate` subjects as `Agent`, the no-tense reading of "The record ends on day 720", the Name-less counted "Forty-four Keepers", and the per-sentence `(Day 720)` without importing `(Year 2)` are all correct.
